data_types.notes: EPUB / PDF files uploaded by the user, plus highlights, notes, and chat messages. Stored in Cloudflare R2 and Workers KV. Required for cross-device sync.
Sign in with Apple stable user identifier (or Google sub). Used to associate sync data.
May be a private relay address per Sign in with Apple. Used for account recovery + transactional email.

Microphone audio is collected only during an active voice conversation, transmitted to the voice service to provide the requested conversation, and not used for advertising or tracking. Users can decline or revoke microphone access in Settings.
Sentry crash + breadcrumb data. First-party. Telemetry can be opted out from Settings.
Sentry performance + breadcrumb data matching PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypePerformanceData. Telemetry can be opted out from Settings.
Anonymous reading-session length + chat-turn counts. Opt-out available in Settings.
